title: Signature USB Enumeration Sequence
description: Walks the standard enumeration: detect, reset, read descriptors, assign address, configure. Each step has timeouts and retries; the host learns what the device is before loading a driver. It is the handshake every USB device performs. title: Signature Safe Removal Protocol
